acceptance_rules: CLINICAL_LOCKOUT: show error.message verbatim ('Patient ticket has been refunded…') and disable editing.
Finalized notes are never edited — offer 'Append correction' (reason required).

Examination consent before the examination field: three buttons, none selected — 'Verbal consent obtained (VCO)', 'Patient declined', 'Not examined' (examination_consent). Never pre-select one; Declined and Not examined disable the examination field. Under the Clinic profile (GET /establishment) the note cannot be finalized without it (EXAMINATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED). The printed note and prescription show 'VCO'.

Under the Clinic profile 'Submit consultation' also needs the complaint (or history), the examination findings when VCO was obtained, a diagnosis and the plan (treatment or referral): mark the empty fields from CONSULTATION_INCOMPLETE details.missing and keep the draft.

Under every finalized note and correction show its author_stamp.text (name, designation, PMDC number, date and time: MSDS 147); 'Print note' = print-payload (A4) or pdf_url, finalized notes only (ENCOUNTER_NOT_FINAL).
'Admit': admission_reason and provisional_diagnosis are required (MSDS 149); pre-fill them from this note's complaint and diagnosis for the doctor to confirm, and offer initial_care_plan.

'Procedure note' (a bedside procedure: chest drain, central line, lumbar puncture): encounter_type Procedure with `procedure` (name, site and side, indication, anaesthesia, the consent from the consent register, the assistant, start and end, technique, findings, specimens, complications, condition at the end). Mark findings, specimens ('None' if nothing was removed) and condition at the end as required; the server refuses to sign without them (PROCEDURE_NOTE_INCOMPLETE, details.missing). MSDS IMS 150.

Diagnosis codes come from the ICD picker (screen icd_picker): store the `code`, show `icd_terms` (code + title) wherever codes appear; ICD_CODE_UNKNOWN means a code not in the active list (details.unknown).

Offer 'Hospital Pharmacy' only while dispensing is Active (GET /establishment; the operation is in x-capability-gates); otherwise the only choice is the printed slip for an outside pharmacy.

External/Local Market prescriptions accept free-text drug names and print a slip; they never enter the pharmacy queue. The slip carries the prescriber's stamp (prescriber_stamp: name, designation, PMDC number, date-time) above the signature line.
Inpatient orders require dose, route, frequency (or PRN/STAT) and start time — the MAR is generated from them.

Outpatient (OPD, ER) lines need the dose, the route, how often and for how many days; a single STAT dose the dose and the route (PRESCRIPTION_INCOMPLETE, details.lines lists each line's missing fields: mark them). The printout (print-payload) is the standard prescription: the patient's particulars, the directions in words ('1 tablet oral twice a day for 5 days'), the prescriber's stamp and a signature line. Printing proves nothing: 'Handed over' (POST /prescriptions/{id}/handover) records to whom (patient, or a named attendant) and how the copy is kept (electronic, carbon copy, or the scan of the signed copy from the patient's documents).

Collect: identify the patient first (body of POST /lab/samples/{id}/collect): scan the wristband (wristband_code; PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH = another patient's band: STOP), or ask two identifiers (identity_check TwoIdentifiers); an emergency patient who cannot be identified yet: EmergencyOverride with identity_note. GET /lab/samples/{sample_id}/label is a print, never a preview: call it only when the user prints or reprints. acceptance_rules: You cannot verify results you entered (LAB_VERIFIER_MUST_DIFFER).
Rejection requires a note.
Verify critical values first: after lab_critical_release_minutes the ordering doctor sees them marked Pending verification.
Verifying a critical result opens it in the critical results log: tell the doctor NOW and record it (screen critical_results_verifier).
A result past its due time: ask for delay_reason (optional) before verifying (MSDS AAC 4).
Verifying signs the result with your stamp (verified_stamp), printed on the lab report under the technician's (performed_stamp).

Each queue row carries its context: open its order with requisition_id (never by the patient's name), compare entered_by with the signed-in user's user_id to warn before LAB_VERIFIER_MUST_DIFFER, and ask for the delay reason when is_overdue (due_at, the server's clock); never derive a deadline from entered_at.

After a lost verify answer, never repeat it by itself: read GET /lab/requisitions/{requisition_id} and find the result_id. Published or Rejected: decided; PendingVerification: offer it again. A row gone from the queue says neither.

acceptance_rules: Worklist first (GET /consent-worklist, `mine` for the caller's patients): the admissions without the general consent, the operations not signed in without their consents (OperationConsent, AnaesthesiaConsent), the signed forms still to scan; `overdue` in red; `consent_id` opens the draft already prepared.

Prepare: the form (GET /consent-forms) and the language the patient understands (only languages the form has; CONSENT_TEXT_MISSING lists details.available). POST /consents with the admission, the operation or the visit fills the patient and what it can (the procedure, the surgeon, the anaesthetist, the need for admission); complete what `missing` lists (the procedure, who performs it, risks, benefits, alternatives; for the general consent the need, the stay and the cost).

Print it (print-payload) and lay out `fields.consent.form_body` in `fields.consent.direction`: rtl (Urdu and the other languages but English) in a Nastaliq or Naskh font, `text` and `pdf_url` are then null. Explain it, read it aloud when the patient cannot read, have it signed or thumb-printed, with the witness.

Record the decision: Sign (signer Patient; or DecisionMaker, with a relationship GET /consent-decision-makers allows for this patient: an adult uses adult_priority, a child minor_priority, else CONSENT_SIGNER_INVALID; the questions and answers; a tick 'the patient explained it back'), or Refuse with the reason (VerbalRefusal: witnessed). In an emergency with nobody to consent: mode EmergencyNote, the note and the second doctor.

The caller is stamped as the professional who explained it: an informed consent needs a registered doctor, anaesthesia a doctor of the anaesthesia team (CONSENT_TAKER_NOT_AUTHORIZED). CONSENT_INCOMPLETE lists details.missing: mark those fields.

Scan the signed paper: upload it as a patient document of type Consent (POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents), then POST /consents/{consent_id}/scan. A decided consent is final: Withdraw it (with the reason) and take a new one. Refresh on consent.updated.

Who signs comes from the consent's who_decides, the server's own rule for this patient: patient_may_sign false (a minor by the hospital's adult_age) offers only a decision maker; offer who_decides.decision_makers in their order and no other relationship; ask for the second doctor of an EmergencyNote when emergency_second_doctor. Never classify the patient or hardcode an age of consent on the terminal.
